content_blocks.label: clause_1._Confidential_Information
content_blocks.text: ‘Confidential Information’ means all information disclosed by Disclosing Party to Receiving Party, whether oral or written, and includes trade secrets, know-how, business methods, customer lists, and technical data.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Duration_of_Obligation
content_blocks.text: Receiving Party’s obligation of confidentiality hereunder shall remain in effect indefinitely, until such time as the Confidential Information becomes publicly known through no fault of Receiving Party.
